notes: Measured locally using completed authentic Drive snapshots, not a new Colab execution.
Canonical keys, full top-hub lists and per-context/relation records are in ignored local Parquets/JSON; no duplicate graph artifacts written.
No policy selected using evaluation results; shortlist is a research tradeoff discussion from training only.
Diagnostic MODULE-off and CREATE-only policies use fixed node-type rules. Other exclusions transfer exact frozen TRAIN context identities; unseen evaluation contexts are retained with weight 1.
Largest component is chosen by total retained nodes (PROCESS ties); largest_process_component_count is also available.
Two-hop statistics are exact for 64 deterministic sampled PROCESS seeds per period, not exact population quantiles.
